data.name: Nisha
data.gender_notes: Nisha is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit niśā, 'night'. Its root is Sanskrit niś (निश्). A classical Sanskrit word for night. Nisha is a Sanskrit name meaning “Night”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nisha expresses “Night”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nisha total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
